name: parallelepiped_comp_equiv
statement: ι → E) (e : ι' ≃ ι) : parallelepiped (v ∘ e) = parallelepiped v

have_tree.body: fun z : ι' → ℝ => e.symm.sum_comp fun i => z i • v (e i)

name: parallelepiped_orthonormalBasis_one_dim
statement: OrthonormalBasis ι ℝ ℝ) : parallelepiped b = Icc 0 1 ∨ parallelepiped b = Icc (-1) 0

name: prod_addHaar
statement: Basis ι ℝ E) (w : Basis ι' ℝ F) : (v.prod w).addHaar = v.addHaar.prod w.addHaar
